day.headline: A Goat day — Rabbit and Pig are in step.

reasons: Horse pairs with Goat — a harmonious day
signs.motif: the search history you would not defend
signs.message: Your search history is unhinged and correct. Go act on it.

reasons: Tiger sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Get there five minutes early. Pick your seat, own the room.

reasons: Snake sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the shoes for standing all day
signs.message: Wear the ones you can stand in all day. Go everywhere.

reasons: Rabbit and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: something borrowed and never given back
signs.message: Ask for it back today. One line, no apology attached.

reasons: Goat's own day — your energy runs high
signs.message: Stone's spun into your palm again. Turn it face-out, go.

reasons: Pig and Goat share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.motif: the last hour of the afternoon
signs.message: Last hour of the afternoon is yours. One small thing, done.

reasons: Dog sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the alarm you did not need
signs.message: Awake before it went off. Delete that alarm, keep the later one.

reasons: Rat sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: the yawn that will not finish
signs.message: Half a yawn all morning. Go stand outside for real air.

reasons: Monkey sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Someone's practicing scales through the wall. Let them, stay in.

reasons: Dragon sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The halving math failed. Eat it anyway, don't attempt round two.

reasons: Rooster sits apart from Goat — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Still sitting in drafts. Let it sit one more day.

reasons: Ox opposes Goat — a day to take slowly
signs.message: You stood so someone else could sit. Tonight, horizontal, no plans.
